name: vendor-esinit
description: Mode V: the real vendor /lib/systemd/esinit runs as PID 1 through OEM/car/country detection, the non-FDE decision and eMMC fsck, then selects the non-FDE fstab. The lge-fan driver attach blocks in QEMU without micom/thermal hardware, so systemd is not reached; partial boot, not stock equivalence.
